title: Hidden Biases in Unreliable News Detection Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Training a Bag-of-Words Logistic Regression model to extract the most salient word features (e.g., celebrity names versus neutral words) and comparing its accuracy against state-of-the-art transformer models to expose underlying dataset artifacts.

Comparing model accuracy on standard random train/test splits versus source-disjoint splits, alongside conducting random label permutation experiments to prove models memorize arbitrary site-label mappings rather than detecting unreliable news.
Evaluating model performance on temporally disjoint datasets by splitting testing data across consecutive months to test if models exploit time-specific events.
